lines.3: 「Samejima. It is wrong to say such things to a girl.」
lines.6: 「Kanisawa, calling him ugly was also unacceptable.」
lines.7: 「Yeah! You shouldn't go around telling people the truth!」
lines.8: 「Didn't we teach you it's wrong to call a bald man bald?」
lines.9: 「Your kindness is bringing salty water to my eyes.」
lines.10: 「That's what he gets for picking on something I'm sensitive about. I don't think I did anything wrong.」
lines.12: 「You need not be so concerned. Is it not enough that your face is so lovely?」
lines.13: 「Your eyes are large and beautifully colored as well. I envy them.」
lines.16: 「Yes, that is probably my family. I told them I would call at eight. I will step out for a moment.」
lines.18: 「You know, Otome is kind of cool.」
lines.20: 「But nobody's ever said anything like that to me before. Everyone always makes fun of me. You know how many nights I've cried into my pillow?」
lines.21: 「That's because you sleep with your mouth open.」
lines.22: 「It wasn't drool! A cute girl like me, made from snowflakes, doesn't secrete anything like that!」
lines.24: 「I've decided to forgive her past crimes and treat her with the respect a senior deserves.」
lines.25: 「I don't think she committed any crimes in the first place.」
lines.26: 「All these guys around, and Otome's the only one who's made my heart skip a beat. What a pathetic bunch.」
lines.28: 「Uh, nobody's said anything to make me feel better.」
lines.29: 「A man isn't defined by his face!」
